change.item: Updated extension metadata to reflect the Joomla package, subpackage, and version information.
Removed the explicit cart removal instruction when initiating Stripe Checkout.
Replaced jQuery-based redirection with native JavaScript.
Replaced the redirect button with a fallback hyperlink.
Improved JavaScript and HTML output security through proper encoding of dynamic values.

fix.item: Improved Stripe Checkout URL validation and error handling.
Enhanced debug logging while avoiding exposure of the complete Checkout URL.

addition.item: Initial release of the Stripe Payment Plugin for HikaShop.
